mentions.name: Mafia Arena
mentions.description: This platform benchmarks large language models on emotional intelligence (EQ) by running Mafia-style social deduction games between LLM players. It is built on Cloudflare and involved solving distributed systems problems; the author is seeking help to run more games.
mentions.problem: Running the games is very expensive, so there are not enough completed games to claim it as a legitimate benchmark.
